name: json-viewer
title: JSON Viewer
description: A bordered code panel that renders a JSON object as an indented tree. Keys and values are colour-coded by type, branches fold open, long arrays truncate, dates get a relative hint, and the header offers Expand All, Collapse All and Copy.
use: A dashboard or API tool must show a raw JSON response that people can fold, read and copy.
avoid: The recorded frames render as an error, so its real look is unverified; deep payloads mean a lot of nested rows.
a11y: Expand and collapse sits on a clickable div, so only the chevron button is keyboard reachable, and it has no label or aria-expanded state. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: Every recorded frame is a near-black stage holding only a grey warning triangle above the words "Preview unavailable", centred in large grey type. The viewer itself, its border, title row and tree never appear.
behaves: From the code, each object or array folds and unfolds on click, its chevron rotating as it opens; the header expands or collapses every branch and copies the payload, and arrays over five items hide behind a Show more button. The frames show none of this.
customise: The data object, header title, default expansion depth, line numbers, colour indent, click or double-click collapse and array truncation are props. Colours and row styling are in the source.
weight: light: Renders only the open branches of the tree; no animation loop.
